title: Easy 35min + 4 strides (travel day)
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 28min at 138-150bpm, 4x20s strides, 2m easy. If flight is early: run in Milan in the evening, same session.
GYM: none.
FUEL: start carb loading: 7-8 g/kg Thu and Fri.
GARMIN: ~35.
STOP RULE: travel fatigue = 20min easy, skip strides.
WHY: legs moving after the flight, no load.
